371: who is beautiful on every occasion and in every place. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As long as she dwelt with her father, the Guru,
her husband, the soul, wandered about in great sadness.
When the soul served and pleased the True Primal Being,
ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ; ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
the Guru brought her into his home, and then he obtained every peace. ॥2॥
She is blessed with thirty-two virtues, and her offspring are the True Name.
She is obedient, refined and beautiful.
She fulfils the desires of her husband and master,
and gives full contentment to her sisters-in-law, hope and desire. ॥3॥
She is the most noble of all the family,
counselling and guiding her brothers-in-law, the senses.
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਇ ॥
Blessed is that household in which she has appeared.
O servant Nanak, life there passes in peace and comfort. ॥4॥3॥
ਮਤਾ ਕਰਉ; ਸੋ ਪਕਨਿ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
Whatever plan I make, Maya does not let it come to fruition.
She stands guard close by gentleness and self-discipline.
She wears many disguises and shows many forms,
ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ. ਬਸਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ; ਵਖਿ ਵਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
and does not let me dwell in my own home; she makes me wander in various ways. ॥1॥
ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਿ; ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ. ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
She has become the mistress of my home, and does not let me live there.
If I make an effort, she entangles me all the more. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
She was sent by the Primal Lord as a servant,
ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ; ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰ ॥
but she has conquered the nine regions of the earth, and every place.
ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
She has not spared even the Yogis and Sanyasis on the river banks and at the sacred shrines.
Those who read the Simritees and study the Vedas have grown weary before her. ॥2॥
Wherever I sit, she sits there with me.
She is powerful, and enters all the worlds.
ਹੋਛੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ; ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Seeking the protection of the weak, I cannot escape her.
ਕਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ; ਹਉ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Tell me, O friend: to whom should I turn? ॥3॥
Hearing the teachings of my friend, I came to the True Guru.
ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
The Guru implanted within me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Singing the glorious praises of the infinite Lord, I now dwell in my own home.
I have met God, O Nanak, and I have become free of worry. ॥4॥
My home is now my own, and she has become my servant.
ਇਹ ਆਮਰਿ; ਹਮ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
The Guru has made her my servant, and has made me intimate with the Lord's Court. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥4॥4॥
First, I was advised to send a letter to the enemy.
Second, I was advised to send two men.
Third, I was advised to make some effort.
ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਛੋਡਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
But I have renounced everything, and I meditate only on You, God. ॥1॥
Now I am in great bliss, free of worry, and in intuitive poise.
ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The enemies and evil ones have perished, and I have found peace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The True Guru has given me this teaching:
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
my soul and body all belong to the Lord, His dwelling place.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੀ; ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Whatever I do, I do by Your strength, Lord.
You are my protection; You are my support. ॥2॥
ਤੁਧਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ; ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈਂ ਧਰਿ ॥
Forsaking You, God, to whom could I turn?
There is no other equal to You.
ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Your servant depends on no one else.
The faithless cynic wanders astray in the wilderness. ॥3॥
Your glorious greatness cannot be described.
ਜਹ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Wherever I am, You save me, hugging me close to You.
Slave Nanak has entered Your sanctuary.
God has preserved his honour, and congratulations pour in. ॥4॥5॥
372: Having crossed through foreign lands, I have come here to do business.
I heard of an incomparable and profitable merchandise.
I have gathered the capital of virtue, tied in my lap.
Beholding this jewel, my mind is fascinated. ॥1॥
O Banker, the traders have come to Your door.
Please bring out the merchandise, and teach us to trade. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Banker, the Lord, has sent me to the Banker, the Guru.
The jewel is priceless, and the capital is priceless.
I have found a loving go-between, a friend;
I have obtained the merchandise, and my consciousness is now steady. ॥2॥
ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਤਸਕਰ; ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
It has no fear of thieves, of wind or of water.
I have purchased it with intuitive ease, and with intuitive ease I shall take it away.
ਸਤ ਕੈ ਖਟਿਐ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Earning it honestly, I have suffered no pain,
and I have brought it home safe and sound. ॥3॥
I have earned the profit, and I am in bliss.
Blessed is the Banker, the perfect Forgiver.
ਇਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
How rare is the Gurmukh who obtains this merchandise!
Nanak has brought home this profitable cargo. ॥4॥6॥
ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ; ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
He does not consider my merits or demerits.
He does not look at my beauty, complexion or adornments.
ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
I do not know the ways of wisdom and good conduct.
But taking me by the arm, my Beloved has led me to His bed. ॥1॥
ਸੁਨਿਬੋ ਸਖੀ; ਕੰਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ, ਕੀਅਲੋ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Listen, O my companions: my Husband Lord has taken care of me.
ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ, ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ. ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Placing His hand upon my forehead, He protects me as His own; what do these ignorant people know? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My married life now appears so beautiful;
ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ; ਮੇਰੋ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਿਓ ॥
my Husband Lord has met me, and He has looked into all my pains.
Within the courtyard of my heart, the moon of glory shines.
Night and day, I delight in my Beloved. ॥2॥
My clothes are dyed the deep crimson of love,
and all my ornaments and the garlands around my neck adorn me.
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪੇਖੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Gazing upon me with His glance, my Beloved has given me all treasures,
and the domination of the evil enemies has come to an end. ॥3॥
I am forever in bliss, and forever enjoy His love.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
With the nine treasures of the Name in my own home, I am satisfied.
Says Nanak, when the happy soul-bride is adorned by her Husband Lord,
she becomes steady, forever with her Husband. ॥4॥7॥
People give charity to the Brahmins and worship them,
yet even as they take, the Brahmins deny any obligation.
ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ; ਤੁਮੑ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
O Brahmin, the door through which you must finally go —
at that door, you shall regret and repent. ॥1॥
Such Brahmins shall drown, O brothers,
who think of doing evil to the innocent. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Within them is greed, and they wander around like mad dogs.
They slander others, and carry the load of slander on their heads.
Plundered by Maya, he does not remember the Lord.
Deluded by doubt, he goes astray down many paths. ॥2॥
Outwardly, they wear many religious robes,
but within, Maya has encircled them and made her camp.
He instructs others, but does not understand himself.
He watches and hears, and is always with you.
Says Nanak, if such is your destiny,
renounce your pride, and grasp the Guru's feet. ॥4॥8॥
373: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਗਤੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Pain and disease have left my body, and my mind has become pure, singing the glorious praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ. ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
I am in bliss, meeting the company of the Holy, and now my mind does not wander anywhere. ॥1॥
My burning has been quenched through the Guru's Word, O mother.
ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਓ ਤਾਪ ਸਭ ਸਹਸਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ. ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All fever and anxiety have departed; I have met the cooling Guru, and abide in intuitive poise and love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ. ਏਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ; ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਅਬ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
My wandering has ended, since I came to know the One and Only Lord; now I have come to dwell in the steady place.
ਜਗਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਨ. ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
Your Saints, O Lord, are the saviours of the world; beholding their vision, I remain satisfied. ॥2॥
ਜਨਮ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਾਛੈ; ਅਬ ਪਕਰੇ, ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
I have left behind the sins of past births, now that I have grasped the feet of the steady Holy Guru.
ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਮੰਗਲ ਮਨੂਆ; ਅਬ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
My mind sings songs of joy in the melody of intuitive poise, and death shall no longer devour it. ॥3॥
ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ. ਸਮਰਥ ਹਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁਖਦਾਈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
O my Lord King, all-powerful Cause of causes, Giver of peace,
ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
Nanak lives by chanting Your Name; You are my help and support, with me through and through, like the warp and weft. ॥4॥9॥
The slanderer cries out and bewails.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ; ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has forgotten the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord; the slanderer reaps the fruit of his own deeds. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਾਲੇ ਲਏ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥
If someone becomes his companion, the slanderer takes him along with him.
ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ; ਨਿੰਦਕੁ. ਅਗਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
The slanderer carries a huge, dragon-like load of his own imagining, and burns in the fire of slander. ॥1॥
ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ, ਜਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Nanak proclaims and tells what happens at the door of the Transcendent Lord:
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
the Lord's humble devotees are forever in bliss; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's praises, they blossom forth. ॥2॥10॥
Even though I adorned myself with every decoration,
ਤਉ ਭੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
still my mind was not satisfied.
I applied many fragrant oils to my body,
ਓਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ; ਤਿਲੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
yet I did not obtain even a tiny bit of that peace.
Within my mind, I hold such a longing:
that I may live by beholding my Beloved, O my mother. ॥1॥
ਮਾਈ. ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
O mother, what should I do? This mind finds no rest.
It is drawn by love for my Beloved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Clothes, ornaments, and so many special pleasures —
ਓਇ ਭੀ ਜਾਨਉ; ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
I know that these too are of no account.
the obedience of the whole world,
and a home as beautiful as a jewel —
only if I am pleasing to God's Will shall I be forever happy. ॥2॥
With delicacies and foods of so many kinds,
with power, property and absolute command,
ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਜਾਇਸਿ ॥
the mind is not satisfied, and its thirst does not depart.
ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ; ਇਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ. ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Without meeting Him, this day does not pass.
ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Meeting God, the soul-bride obtains every peace. ॥3॥
Searching and searching, I have heard this news:
without the company of the Holy, no one swims across.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who has good destiny written on the forehead finds the True Guru.
Her hopes are fulfilled, and her mind is satisfied.
When she meets God, her burning longing is extinguished.
O Nanak, she has found the Lord within her mind and body. ॥4॥11॥
374: First, yours is a noble birth as a human being.
But your form is ugly, for there is pride in your mind. ॥1॥
O beautiful, attractive, wise and clever soul-bride,
ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬੈ; ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
you are trapped by your great pride and attachment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You bathe, worship, and apply a red mark to your forehead.
You make a show of yourself with your words, and speak of wisdom with your mouth.
But the dog of greed has destroyed all your glory. ॥2॥
You wear fine clothes and enjoy pleasures;
you practise good conduct to win acclaim in the world;
you apply perfumes, sandalwood and many fragrances;
but your companion is evil, the demon of anger. ॥3॥
All other species are your servants;
on this earth, yours is the rule.
You possess gold, silver and wealth,
but sexual desire has spoiled your good nature. ॥4॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
That soul-bride upon whom the Sovereign Lord casts His glance of mercy
Joining the company of the Holy, she tastes the essence of the Lord.
Says Nanak, that body is fruitful. ॥5॥
ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ. ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ; ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
All beauty and all pleasures become yours when you become a happy soul-bride;
ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥
then you are truly very beautiful and wise. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥12॥
One who appears alive in the pride of Maya is sure to die a spiritual death.
One who is dead to it remains forever steady. ॥1॥
Those who live in pride are dead, and those who are dead to it are alive.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਅਵਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They place the medicine of the Lord's Name in their mouths, and through the Guru's Word they drink in the ambrosial essence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The clay pot of the body shall surely break.
ਜਿਸੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
One who is rid of the furrowed brow of anger dwells in one's own true home. ॥2॥
One who climbs up high in pride falls into the pit of the underworld.
ਧਰਨਿ ਪੜੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
One who lies humbly on the ground is not touched by death. ॥3॥
ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those who wander around obtain nothing.
Those who practise the Guru's Word become steady. ॥4॥
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ; ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
This soul and body all belong to the Lord.
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, they are enraptured. ॥5॥13॥
The puppet of your body has been fashioned with great skill.
Know for certain that it shall become dust. ॥1॥
Remember your origin, O heedless fool!
ਇਤਨੇ ਕਉ; ਤੁਮੑ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why are you so proud of so little? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are a guest in this world, given three measures of food a day;
everything else has been entrusted to you. ॥2॥
You are just excrement, bones and blood, wrapped up in skin,
yet this is what you take such pride in! ॥3॥
ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ; ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
If you were to understand the One Thing, the Name, then you would become pure.
Without understanding, you shall be forever impure. ॥4॥
Says Nanak, be a sacrifice to the Guru,
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
through whom the all-knowing Primal Lord is found. ॥5॥14॥
ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
Even a moment of the day apart from my Beloved feels like many days.
ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ; ਕੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
My mind cannot rest; how can I meet my Beloved? ॥1॥
ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Not a single moment, not a single day, ever seems to pass.
375: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ. ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ; ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind has such a great longing for His vision; if only some Saint would unite me with my Husband Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The four watches of the day are like the four ages to me,
ਰੈਣਿ ਭਈ; ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
and when night comes, it seems never to end. ॥2॥
The five demons have joined together to separate the soul-bride from her Husband Lord.
Wandering and wandering, she weeps and wrings her hands. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord has revealed the vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;
examining his own soul, he has obtained supreme peace. ॥4॥15॥
In the Lord's service is the supreme treasure.
To chant the Ambrosial Name with one's mouth is the Lord's service. ॥1॥
The Lord is my companion; He is with me as my friend.
ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ. ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ; ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In pain and in pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present; how could the wretched messenger of death frighten me? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ; ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
The Lord is my protection; the Lord is my strength.
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
The Lord is my friend; He is the support of my mind. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth; the Lord is my Banker. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
By the Guru's grace, this understanding has come;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ॥4॥16॥
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ; ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
When God is merciful, then one attaches this mind to the Guru.
Serving the True Guru, all fruits are obtained. ॥1॥
ਮਨ. ਕਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਹਿਗਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
O my mind, why are you so anxious? My True Guru is perfect.
ਮਨਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ. ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is the Giver of the mind's desires, the treasure of all peace; His ambrosial pool is forever overflowing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who enshrines His lotus feet within the heart —
the divine light is revealed within him, and he meets the Beloved Lord. ॥2॥
The five companions, the senses, have joined to sing songs of joy,
and the unstruck melody of the Bani resounds. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
O Nanak, when the Guru is pleased, one meets the Lord, the King,
and the night of one's life passes in peace, intuitive poise and love. ॥4॥17॥
Showing His mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.
Meeting the True Guru, I have obtained the perfect wealth. ॥1॥
Gather such wealth of the Lord, O brothers,
ਭਾਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਲੈ, ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ; ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ. ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that fire cannot burn, and water cannot drown; it does not leave you to go anywhere else. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
It does not decrease, and it does not run out.
Eating and spending it, the mind remains satisfied. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ ॥
He is a true banker, within whose home the Lord's wealth is gathered.
ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
With this wealth, the whole world profits. ॥3॥
ਤਿਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
He alone obtains the Lord's wealth, who is destined to receive it by past deeds.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਤਿ ਵਾਰ; ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
O servant Nanak, at the very last moment, the Name is one's only ornament. ॥4॥18॥
As the farmer plants his crop,
and cuts it down, whether it is ripe or unripe, O mortal, ॥1॥
so know that whoever is born shall die.
ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ; ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only the devotee of the Lord of the Universe becomes steady. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The day shall surely be followed by the night,
and when the night passes, there shall again be morning. ॥2॥
In the love of Maya, the unfortunate ones remain asleep.
By the Guru's grace, a rare few remain awake. ॥3॥
376: Says Nanak, sing the glorious praises of the Lord forever,
and your face shall be radiant, and your consciousness pure. ॥4॥19॥
The nine treasures are Yours, all treasures are Yours.
You are the Fulfiller of desires, who protects us in the end. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ; ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
You are my Beloved, so what hunger can I have?
ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਲਗੈ ਨ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When You dwell within my mind, pain does not touch me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O True Lord and Master, True is Your command. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
When it pleases You, then I sing Your glorious praises, Lord.
ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੩॥
Within Your home, there is justice, forever and ever. ॥3॥
O True Lord and Master, You are unseen and mysterious.
O Nanak, one is committed to His service only when He commits him. ॥4॥20॥
ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
He is near at hand, forever with every soul.
His creative power pervades all forms and colours. ॥1॥
ਕਰ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਝੁਰੈ; ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
My mind does not fret, nor does it grieve or cry out,
ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ. ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for my Husband Lord is imperishable, unseen and inaccessible, forever safe and sound. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਰੇ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
On whom does Your humble servant depend?
His Sovereign Lord Himself preserves his honour. ॥2॥
That slave whom God has freed from the pride of social status —
ਤਿਸੁ ਲਉਡੇ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
who can now hold that slave in envy? ॥3॥
The Lord is independent and carefree;
O slave Nanak, proclaim "Wonderful!" to the great Lord. ॥4॥21॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ; ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Forsaking the sublime essence of the Lord, the mortal is intoxicated with shallow pleasures.
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
The treasure is within the home of his heart, but he runs outside to look for it. ॥1॥
ਸੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਥਾ ॥
He cannot bear to hear the true, ambrosial sermon,
ਰਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ; ਝੂਠੀ ਲਗਿ ਗਾਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but attached to false tales, he quarrels. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He takes his wages from his Lord and Master, but serves another.
With such sins, the mortal is engulfed. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਕ; ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ॥
He tries to hide from the One who is always with him.
ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੩॥
He begs again and again for what is of no use to him. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, O God, merciful to the meek,
as it pleases You, please cherish and protect us. ॥4॥22॥
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
The Name of the Lord is the wealth of the soul and the breath of life.
Here and hereafter, it is of use to the soul. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ; ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
Without the Lord's Name, everything else is lacking.
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind is satisfied and fulfilled by the vision of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Guru's Bani is a treasure of devotion, a treasure of jewels.
Singing, hearing and acting upon it, one is enraptured. ॥2॥
One's mind is attached to the Lord's lotus feet,
when the True Guru, being pleased, bestows this gift. ॥3॥
One to whom the Guru has given the teaching, O Nanak,
recognises the imperishable God in each and every heart. ॥4॥23॥
The all-pervading Lord has established all the joys and wonders of the world.
He Himself has embellished His own creation. ॥1॥
Perfect is the creation of the perfect Lord and Master,
ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀ; ਸੋਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whose glory is pervading everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
His Name is the treasure, and His praise makes all pure.
He Himself is the Creator; there is no other. ॥2॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
All beings and creatures are in His hands.
ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
God is pervading in all, and is with all. ॥3॥
377: The perfect Guru has made this perfect arrangement:
O Nanak, the Lord's devotees are blessed with glory. ॥4॥24॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
Through the Word of the Guru, fashion this mind anew.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
The Word is the Guru's vision; through it, gather the wealth of the Lord. ॥1॥
ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ; ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਉ ॥
O sublime understanding, please come into my heart,
ਧਿਆਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that I may meditate and sing the glorious praises of the Lord of the Universe, and that the Name may become very dear to me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I am satisfied and fulfilled by the True Name.
My cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage is the dust of the Saints. ॥2॥
I recognise that the One Creator is contained in all.
Joining the company of the Holy, my understanding has become discerning. ॥3॥
I have become the servant of all, renouncing my pride.
The Guru has given this gift to Nanak. ॥4॥25॥
My intellect has been enlightened, and my understanding has become perfect.
Thus my evil-mindedness, which kept me far from Him, has been dispelled. ॥1॥
Such are the teachings I have received from the Guru,
ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that while I was drowning in the dark, deep well, I was pulled out, O my brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The world is a fathomless ocean of fire;
the Guru, the treasure of jewels, is the boat that carries us across. ॥2॥
This Maya is so dark and treacherous, so difficult to cross;
the perfect Guru has revealed the clear path through it. ॥3॥
ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ; ਕਛੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
I have no chanting, no penance, no cleverness at all.
Prays Nanak, O Guru, I have entered Your sanctuary. ॥4॥26॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Drinking in the essence of the Lord, one is forever imbued with it,
ਆਨ ਰਸਾ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
while other pleasures wear off in an instant.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ; ਮਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Intoxicated with the essence of the Lord, the mind is forever in bliss,
while other pleasures bring only anxiety. ॥1॥
One who drinks in the essence of the Lord is utterly enraptured, intoxicated with it;
ਆਨ ਰਸਾ; ਸਭਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
all other pleasures are shallow. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The value of the essence of the Lord cannot be described.
The essence of the Lord is kept in the shop of the Holy Guru.
It cannot be purchased, even with thousands and millions.
He alone receives it, Lord, to whom You give it, as destined. ॥2॥
O Nanak, tasting it, one is wonderstruck.
O Nanak, this taste comes from the Guru.
ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ; ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Here and hereafter, he does not leave it to go anywhere else;
Nanak is absorbed in the essence of the Lord. ॥3॥27॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ; ਛੁਟਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ. ਅਪੁਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
If the soul-bride erases sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, and is rid of the evil-mindedness she herself has fostered,
ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
and if she becomes humble and serves Him, then she becomes dear to the mind of her Beloved. ॥1॥
Listen, O beautiful soul-bride: the Word of the Holy Guru shall save you.
ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ; ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ, ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your pain, hunger and doubt shall be dispelled, and you shall find peace, O bride who longs for peace of mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ. ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਆਤਮ ਸੁਧੁ. ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Washing the Guru's feet and serving Him, the soul is purified, and the poisonous thirst is quenched.
ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿ ਦਾਸਰੀ; ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
If you become the slave of the slaves of the Lord, then you shall obtain honour at the Lord's Court. ॥2॥
ਇਹੀ ਅਚਾਰ ਇਹੀ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ. ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Let this be your right conduct, and this your daily practice: obey the Lord's Will; this is your devotional worship.
ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੋ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
O Nanak, whoever practises this teaching swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ॥3॥28॥
378: You have obtained this human body.
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ; ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.
ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ; ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
Nothing else will be of any use to you.
Join the company of the Holy, and meditate only on the Name. ॥1॥
Make the effort to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ; ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are wasting this life in vain, in the love of Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ; ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
I have not practised chanting, penance, self-discipline or righteous living;
ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
I have not known how to serve the Holy, O my Sovereign Lord.
Says Nanak, my deeds are lowly;
I have sought Your sanctuary; please preserve my honour. ॥2॥29॥
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Without You, I have no other; You alone are in my mind.
ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
You are my friend and companion, my God; why should my soul be afraid? ॥1॥
You are my protection, You are my hope.
ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ; ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ. ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
While sitting and standing, sleeping and waking, with every breath and morsel of food, may I never forget You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ; ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
Protect me, protect me, God, in Your sanctuary; the ocean of fire is so terrifying.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
O True Guru, Giver of peace to Nanak, I am Your child, O Lord of the World. ॥2॥30॥
The Lord God has saved His humble servants.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ. ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ. ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind is reconciled with my Beloved, and the fever has died, as if it had taken poison. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਾਲਾ ਤਾਊ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
Neither cold nor heat touches me, as I sing the glorious praises of the Lord's Name.
ਡਾਕੀ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
The witch, Maya, has no power over my consciousness, for I seek the sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
By the grace of the Saint, the Lord has become merciful; He Himself has become my help.
ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੧॥
Nanak ever sings the praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue; his doubt and pain have been dispelled. ॥2॥31॥
I have taken the medicine of the Lord's Name.
I have found peace, and the seat of pain has been destroyed. ॥1॥
The fever has departed, through the teachings of the perfect Guru.
ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am in bliss, and all my sorrows have been dispelled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All beings and creatures find peace,
O Nanak, meditating within their minds on the Supreme Lord God. ॥2॥32॥
That time, which no one wants, has come.
Without the Lord's Command, how can one understand, however much one is made to understand? ॥1॥
The body is consumed by water, fire or earth.
ਓਹੁ; ਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬੂਢਾ. ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
But the soul is neither young nor old, O brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Slave Nanak has entered the sanctuary of the Holy Guru.
By the Guru's grace, he has crossed over the fear of death. ॥2॥33॥
Forever and ever, the soul is illumined,
for one who, in the company of the Holy, dwells at the Lord's feet. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Chant the Lord's Name every day, O my mind.
ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ. ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You shall find coolness, tranquillity and lasting peace, and all your sins shall depart, O mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥
Says Nanak, one who has perfect good destiny
meets the True Guru, and obtains the perfect Supreme Lord God. ॥2॥34॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
One who has the Lord God, the Master, as his friend —
379: ਪੀੜ ਗਈ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਨਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his pain is gone, and he shall never suffer again. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Granting His grace, the Lord unites him with His feet,
and he finds peace, intuitive poise and bliss; his life becomes comfortable. ॥1॥
In the company of the Holy, he sings the praises of the immeasurable Lord.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, he has become priceless. ॥2॥35॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ; ਏ ਖੇਲਤ. ਸਭਿ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Sexual desire, anger, intoxication with Maya and jealousy — he has lost all these in the game of chance.
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ; ਇਹ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Truth, contentment, compassion, righteousness and truthfulness — these he has brought into the home of his own heart. ॥1॥
All the burdens of birth and death have been removed.
ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ. ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ. ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Joining the Society of the Saints, the mind has become pure; the perfect Guru has carried it across in an instant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੂਆ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
The mind has become the dust of all, and all seem to be beloved friends.
ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
My Lord and Master is contained in all; He gives His gifts to all beings, and cherishes them. ॥2॥
ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ. ਆਪਿ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ; ਏਕੈ ਹੈ. ਸਗਲਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥
He Himself is the One and Only; the One alone is the expanse of all.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ; ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Chanting and meditating, all have become Holy; meditating on the One Name, they have saved many. ॥3॥
ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ, ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
O profound, unfathomable, infinite Lord of the world, You have no end or limit, no near or far shore.
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ; ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩੬॥
By Your grace, Nanak sings Your glorious praises; meditating and meditating on God, he bows to Him. ॥4॥36॥
ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਇਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
You are infinite, unmanifest and imperceptible; all this is Your creation.
ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਹ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ; ਜਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
What cleverness can we beings try, when everything is within You? ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਅਪਨੇ ਬਾਲਿਕ ਰਾਖਹੁ. ਲੀਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
O my True Guru, protect Your child through Your wondrous play.
ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Bless me with sublime understanding, that I may forever sing Your glorious praises, O my inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਨਿ ਜਠਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਓਹੁ ਰਹਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
As the mortal in the mother's womb lives by the support of the Name,
ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ; ਨਾ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
he is in bliss, and remembers Him with every breath, and the fire does not touch him. ॥2॥
ਪਰ ਧਨ. ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ. ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Others' wealth, others' spouses, the slander of others — take away my love for these.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੇਵੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
May I serve the Lord's lotus feet within my heart, through the support of the perfect Guru. ॥3॥
ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ; ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਗਾਰਿ ॥
The houses, mansions and palaces that you see — none of them shall go along with you.
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ. ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥
As long as you live in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O servant Nanak, remember the Name. ॥4॥37॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਜੋਬਨ. ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ; ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਜੋੁਆਨੀ ॥
Power, property, youth, household, fame and the beauty of youth;
ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਘੋੜੇ; ਲਾਲ ਲਾਖ ਬੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
great wealth, elephants and horses, and jewels purchased for tens of thousands —
ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
hereafter, these shall be of no use in the Lord's Court; the proud must leave them behind and depart. ॥1॥
Why attach your consciousness to any other than the One Lord?
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Sitting and standing, sleeping and waking, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਆਖਾੜੇ; ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਪਵਾੜੇ ॥
One may win the most wonderful and beautiful wrestling arenas, and be victorious in the battles on the battlefield;
380: ਹਉ ਮਾਰਉ. ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ. ਛੋਡਉ; ਮੁਖ ਤੇ. ਏਵ ਬਬਾੜੇ ॥
and boast with his mouth, "I can kill, I can imprison, and I can set free" —
ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ; ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਏਕ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ॥੨॥
but when the Command of the Supreme Lord God comes, he leaves it all and departs in a single day. ॥2॥
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
He performs all sorts of religious rituals and deeds, but he does not know the Creator Lord, the Doer of all.
ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ. ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਤਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
He teaches others, but does not practise it himself; he does not realise the essence of the Word.
ਨਾਂਗਾ ਆਇਆ. ਨਾਂਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ; ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Naked he came, and naked he shall depart; he is like the elephant, throwing dust on itself. ॥3॥
ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤਾ; ਝੂਠਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
O Saints and friends, listen, all of you: false is this expanse of the world.
ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਡੂਬੇ; ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
Continually crying "mine, mine", the fools have drowned; they waste away and die.
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੮॥
Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I meditate on the Name; through the True Name, I am emancipated. ॥4॥1॥38॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
The whole world is asleep in doubt, blinded by worldly entanglements; how rare is the humble servant of the Lord who is awake. ॥1॥
ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਗਨ; ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੨॥
The world is intoxicated by the great enticer, Maya, whose love it holds dearer than life; how rare is the one who renounces it. ॥2॥
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਧੂ ॥੩॥
The Lord's lotus feet are incomparable, and so is the teaching of the Saints; how rare is the holy one who is attached to them. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੯॥
O Nanak, in the company of the Holy, one awakens to the love of spiritual wisdom; by great good fortune, grace is bestowed. ॥4॥1॥39॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ; ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Whatever pleases You is acceptable to Your servants; that alone brings peace and poise to their minds.
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, all-powerful and infinite; there is no other at all. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ; ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Your humble servants sing Your glorious praises with joy and relish.
ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮਤਾ. ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever You do and cause to be done — accepting that is Your servant's counsel, decision and wisdom. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Your Name is ambrosial nectar, O Beloved Lord; in the company of the Holy, I have obtained its essence.
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ; ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Those humble beings who sing of the Lord, the treasure of peace, are satisfied and fulfilled, and become perfect. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਾ ਕਉ. ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
One who has Your support, O Lord and Master, is not afflicted by anxiety.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਈ; ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਭਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
Those who are blessed by Your mercy are the good and fortunate bankers. ॥3॥
ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਕਸੇ; ਜਬ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Doubt, attachment and deception have all departed since I obtained the vision of His Darshan.
ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
O Nanak, I have made the True Name my daily practice, and I am absorbed in the love of the Lord's Name. ॥4॥1॥40॥
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਰਾਈ; ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
The slanderer washes off the filth of others' many lifetimes, and reaps the fruit of his own actions.
ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ; ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਚਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
He finds no peace in this world, and no place in the Court of the Lord; he goes to the city of death, and wastes away there. ॥1॥
The slanderer has lost the priceless human life.
ਪਹੁਚਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ; ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He cannot equal the Saints in anything at all, and hereafter he finds no place of rest. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਾ; ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Such is the fate of the wretched slanderer, born of his past deeds; what can the poor wretch do?
ਤਹਾ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ; ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
He is ruined there, where no one can protect him; to whom should he complain? ॥2॥
